label: TP
reason: User-supplied header name flows directly into 'bar', which becomes the input string for encryption. The encrypted bytes are then converted back to a String via new String(input) and passed to encodeForHTML(), whose output is concatenated into the HTTP response stream. There is no filtering or validation preventing arbitrary header names from being used as the plaintext payload, enabling XSS via obfuscated HTML/script content within the encrypted blob.

evidence.note: header name flows to bar -> encrypted -> decoded to string -> encoded for HTML -> printed to response
